edits.reason: CRW-1083: chat index --verify (content-verified freshness) is listed in the synopsis and described, as the usage text of the port lists it

old:
metadata:
  short-description: "Read-only recall search over ~/.codex: past chats (FTS-indexed) + memory store."

new: - `--verify` on `crw recall chat index` decides which rollout files changed from their content, so a rewrite that kept the size and the millisecond mtime is found; the default refresh compares size, mtime and file identity only. With `--status` it reports without writing.
